name: PufferGo | 外贸独立站AI建站专家 | AI Website Builder for Export
author: puffergo

sections.description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Search for PufferGo in WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New, or manually upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/puffergo.
  2. Activate PufferGo in the Plugins page.
  3. Go to the PufferGo settings page to connect your account and start building.
sections.faq:
Is PufferGo free to use?

Yes, we offer a free tier that’s enough to create a complete website. More advanced features are available with paid plans.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. We’ve eliminated all technical barriers, and top-tier AI models from both China and the US are here to assist you. If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us—we’re happy to help. Of course, if you do have technical skills, you’ll find it even smoother to use, but the difference isn’t huge.

How does it help with SEO?

We generate Tailwind HTML code that’s extremely clean and loads incredibly fast. Unlike traditional website builders (like Elementor), there’s no bloated, redundant code.

Where is the data stored?

Only your account-related data is stored on our cloud servers. All other data remains on your own server.
sections.changelog:
0.29.0

  • Every Image Slot Now Tells You What Size to Upload — You no longer have to guess how big a photo should be. Select any image in a section and the panel tells you the exact size, aspect ratio and format to prepare — and a “Crop it” link takes you straight to our cropping tool with those numbers already filled in, so you never have to copy them by hand. The sizes are not estimates: we render every component in a real browser and measure each slot, so what you see is what that position actually needs.
  • The Advice Fits the Slot, Not a One-Size-Fits-All Rule — A full-screen banner, a product card and a customer logo need completely different things, so they get completely different advice. Banners get a width range and a note to keep your subject centred, because their height changes with each visitor’s screen. Logos and certificates are told to keep any shape they like on a transparent background — asking you to squeeze a square logo into a wide strip would be nonsense. Only slots with a genuinely fixed shape get an exact size and ratio.
  • Recommended Sizes Are Tuned to Keep Your Pages Fast — Bigger is not better. Image file size grows with the square of its width, and a photo that is twice as wide can be four times heavier, which your visitors pay for on every page load — especially on phones. The suggested sizes are capped so your pages stay sharp without becoming slow, and WebP is recommended throughout for smaller files at the same quality.
  • Phones Now Download Small Images, Not Full-Size Ones — Until now every visitor downloaded the same full-size photo, whether they were on a 27-inch monitor or a phone on mobile data. WordPress has quietly been saving smaller copies of every image you upload since day one — we simply were not using them. Now each image offers the browser the full set of sizes and lets it pick the right one, which measured out at roughly a third less image data on a phone with no visible difference on desktop. You do not prepare anything extra and you do not change how you work: upload one photo exactly as before. This also clears Google’s “Properly size images” warning, which counts towards your Core Web Vitals score. It applies to blog posts, case studies, solutions and product pages as well as sections.
  • Blog and Case Study Header Images Are No Longer Stretched — Featured images at the top of an article were being served at 1024 pixels wide and then stretched to fill a screen half again as wide, which looked soft on every display regardless of device. They now use the full-resolution photo, and the thumbnails in “related articles” lists were similarly undersized and have been corrected.
  • Round Portraits No Longer Squash Faces — Team photos, author avatars and testimonial portraits used to stretch sideways if the photo you uploaded was not perfectly square — faces came out visibly widened. They now crop to the centre instead, keeping people looking like themselves whatever shape your original photo is. 83 image positions across 16 components were corrected.
  • Embed Videos from YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok and More — Paste a video link straight into an image slot and the section turns into a working player. Self-hosted uploads are checked too: if you upload a format browsers cannot actually play, we tell you at the moment you pick it rather than letting you discover a blank space after publishing.
  • A Polished Starting Point, and Fixes Throughout — New sites now begin with a professional preset rather than waiting on AI to decide the look, so you can start editing immediately. Alongside that: carousel dots now highlight and jump to the right slide, SVG icons no longer collapse to nothing in the edit panel or lose their shape when rendered, and several sections that ignored your site width setting now follow it properly.
  • 14 New Sections for Export Manufacturers — The section library grows with templates built specifically for factories selling overseas: a “how it works” explainer, an OEM vs. ODM comparison, a company timeline, an application-scenarios showcase, a product spotlight with a “view category” button, and several photo-forward full-width/2-column/3-column sections for pages that were getting text-heavy. A handful of thin, image-light “breather” sections are included too, for pausing between two heavier blocks without a full section’s weight.
  • Process Steps Adapt to How Many You Actually Have — The step-by-step “how it works” section no longer assumes exactly four steps. Add a fifth or sixth and the layout reflows on its own; each step now carries its own photo instead of being text-only.

0.29.0 (中文版)

  • 每个图片位都会告诉你该传多大 — 不用再猜图片尺寸了。选中版面里任意一张图，面板上直接写着该准备多大、什么比例、什么格式，旁边一个「去裁剪」链接点过去，我们的裁剪工具已经把这些数字填好了，你不用手抄。这些尺寸不是估的：我们用真实浏览器把每个组件渲染一遍、逐个量出来，看到的就是那个位置实际需要的。
  • 不同的位给不同的建议，而不是一刀切 — 全屏大banner、产品卡片、客户 logo，需要的东西完全不同，给的建议也就完全不同。banner 给的是宽度范围，外加一句”主体居中、四周留出裁切余量”，因为它的高度会随每位访客的屏幕变化；logo 和证书则告诉你比例随意、建议透明底——要求客户把方形 logo 拉成长条本来就是荒唐的。只有形状真正固定的位置，才会给出确切的尺寸和比例。
  • 推荐尺寸经过控制，不会拖慢你的网站 — 图不是越大越好。图片体积随宽度的平方增长，宽度翻一倍、体积可能变成四倍，而这份代价是访客每次打开页面都要付的，手机上尤其明显。我们给的建议尺寸设了上限，保证清晰的同时不让页面变慢，并且全程建议用 WebP 格式——同样的画质，文件更小。
  • 手机不再下载整张大图 — 过去无论访客用的是 27 寸显示器还是流量上网的手机，下载的都是同一张全尺寸原图。其实 WordPress 从一开始就在默默地给你上传的每张图存好了几个小尺寸副本，只是我们一直没用上。现在每张图会把整套尺寸都交给浏览器，由它自己挑合适的那一档——实测下来手机端的图片流量少了约三分之一，桌面端画质一点不降。你不需要多准备任何东西，也不用改变操作习惯，还是照旧传一张图就行。这同时也消掉了 Google 的「Properly size images」告警，那一项是算进 Core Web Vitals 分数的。除了版面区块，博客、案例、方案、产品页也一并覆盖。
  • 博客和案例的头图不再被拉伸 — 文章顶部的特色图过去只取 1024 像素宽，却要铺满宽度大它一半的屏幕，结果在任何设备上看都是发虚的。现在改用原图分辨率；「相关文章」里的缩略图同样偏小，也一并修正了。
  • 圆形头像不会再把人脸压扁 — 团队成员照片、文章作者头像、客户评价里的人像，过去只要你上传的照片不是正方形，就会被横向拉伸，脸明显变宽。现在改成居中裁切，无论你的原图是什么形状，人物比例都是正常的。本次共修正了 16 个组件里的 83 个图片位。
  • 支持嵌入 YouTube、Vimeo、TikTok 等平台视频 — 把视频链接粘贴到图片位里，版面就变成一个能播的播放器。自己上传的视频文件也会检查：如果传的格式浏览器根本播不了，我们在你选中的那一刻就提醒，而不是等你发布完才发现页面上是一片空白。
  • 开局更完整，以及一批修复 — 新站点现在直接用一套成熟的专业预设开局，不必等 AI 决定风格，你可以立刻开始编辑。另外：轮播图的圆点现在能正确高亮并跳到对应那一张；SVG 图标不再在编辑面板里塌成看不见，渲染时也不会走形；还有几个不跟随站点宽度设置的板块，现在会正常跟随了。
  • 新增 14 个外贸制造业专用组件 — 组件库补充了一批专为出海工厂设计的版面：「如何运作」讲解区、OEM/ODM 对比、企业发展历程、应用场景展示、带「查看分类」按钮的产品推荐，以及几个以图片为主的全宽/两栏/三栏通用版面，专治文案堆太多显得单调。还加了几个轻量的过渡带组件，用于两个重区块之间换气，不占版面。
  • 流程步骤区块不再锁死四步 — 「如何运作」的步骤区块以前固定四步，现在加减到五步、六步都会自动重新排布；每一步也配上了自己的实拍图，不再是纯文字。

0.28.0

  • Show Your Factory in Motion — Swap a Photo for a Video — Large image slots in hero and feature sections now take a video just as easily as a picture. Click “Replace Media”, and your image library shows photos and videos side by side — pick whichever you want and the page adapts by itself. There is no “convert to video” step to learn. The photo you replace automatically becomes the video’s cover image, so the section still looks right in the split second before the video starts, and your page keeps a picture for Google and for social shares.
  • Update a Component Without Rebuilding It by Hand — When we improve a component you already have on a page, you can now bring it up to date without retyping anything. The latest version is inserted right below the old one with all your text and images carried across, so you can compare the two side by side on the real page and delete whichever you don’t want. Nothing is overwritten, so there is nothing to undo if you change your mind. This works for components edited through a settings panel.
  • Your Content Is Protected During an Update — Several ways an update could quietly lose your work have been closed off. Rows you filled in are no longer trimmed away when a component’s rows don’t all have the same fields; new settings we add are now filled in properly instead of leaving gaps that break the section; and if you have the same component twice on one page, we no longer risk removing the wrong copy — when we cannot be certain which one is the old version, we keep both and let you delete the right one yourself.
  • Visitors Never See a Half-Finished Update — While you are comparing the two versions, the new one is hidden from your live site. Even if you save the page mid-comparison, visitors and Google only ever see one copy of the section — no duplicate headings, no duplicate content hurting your SEO.
  • We Only Interrupt You for Real Fixes — Cosmetic redesigns of a component no longer nag you to update. The update entry sits quietly as a single line at the top of the edit panel. It only speaks up when we have actually fixed a bug, and when it does it tells you exactly what was fixed, so you can decide whether it affects your site.
  • Fixes Reach You Even If You Skip Many Releases — If a fix ships in one release and you don’t update for months, the notice is still waiting for you when you come back, no matter how many versions went by in between.
  • Background Videos Now Play Properly on iPhone — A background video used to jump into fullscreen playback on iPhone instead of sitting quietly behind your text. It now plays inline the way it does everywhere else.
  • Zalo Added to the Floating Contact Bar — Buyers in Vietnam can now reach you on Zalo straight from the floating contact bar. Social icons across the footer and contact bar were also redrawn from the official brand set, so they line up properly and show in full brand colour instead of grey. A tooltip that could vanish when you moved the mouse diagonally towards it now stays put.

0.28.0 (中文版)

  • 让工厂动起来——图片位可以直接换成视频 — 首屏大图和特色板块的大图位，现在放视频和放图片一样简单。点「替换媒体」，素材库里图片和视频并排显示，你选哪个页面就变成哪个，不用先学会”怎么把图转成视频”。被替换掉的那张图会自动成为视频封面，所以视频加载出来之前那一瞬间版面不会空掉，同时页面上也仍然留着一张图供 Google 抓取和社交分享使用。
  • 组件有更新，不用再重新做一遍 — 我们改进了某个组件时，页面上已有的那一块现在可以直接更新，不用照着旧的重新填一遍文案。新版本会插入到旧版正下方，你填的文字和图片全部带过去，可以在真实页面上左右对照，留下满意的那个、删掉另一个。全程不覆盖任何东西，反悔了直接删掉新的就行。适用于通过配置面板编辑的组件。
  • 更新过程中你的内容不会丢 — 堵掉了几个更新时可能悄悄弄丢内容的口子：组件各行字段不一致时，你填的内容不会再被裁掉；我们新增的配置项现在会正确补齐，不会留下空缺导致板块出错；同一个页面放了两个相同组件时，也不会再删错那一个——凡是不能百分百确定哪个是旧版的情况，两个都留着，由你自己删掉该删的那个。
  • 访客不会看到「改到一半」的页面 — 你在对比两个版本期间，新的那一块对外是隐藏的。就算对比到一半保存了页面，访客和 Google 也只会看到一份内容——不会出现重复标题，也不会因为重复内容影响 SEO。
  • 只有真的修了问题才打扰你 — 组件的纯外观改版不再提示你更新。更新入口平时只是编辑面板顶部一行小字，安安静静待着；只有我们确实修复了问题时它才会开口，并且直接告诉你修的是什么，你可以自己判断这个问题跟你的站有没有关系。
  • 隔了很多个版本才回来，修复照样收得到 — 某个修复在某一版发布，你几个月没更新，中间又过了很多个版本——再回来时这条提示仍然在等你，不会因为中间隔了多少版就消失。
  • 背景视频在 iPhone 上终于正常播放 — 以前背景视频在 iPhone 上会跳成全屏播放，而不是安静地衬在文字后面。现在它跟在其他设备上一样内嵌播放。
  • 悬浮联系条新增 Zalo — 越南客户可以直接通过悬浮联系条上的 Zalo 联系你。页脚和联系条的社交图标同时换成了官方品牌图标集，比例对齐、显示品牌全彩而不再是灰色。另修复了鼠标斜向移过去时提示气泡偶发消失的问题。

0.26.0

  • Redesign Your Live Site Without Losing Google Rankings — The holding page now comes in two flavours. Pick “brand-new site” and visitors see a Coming Soon page while search engines start getting to know your domain early. Pick “already live, being redesigned” and visitors see an Upgrading page while search engines are told your pages still exist and are only temporarily away — so your existing rankings are held and come back automatically the moment you finish. The page also picks the right wording for each case, so returning customers never land on “Coming Soon” and assume you have gone out of business.
  • Holding Page No Longer Blocks Google From Reading Your Site — Previously the holding page also took over robots.txt, which could make Google stop crawling the whole site. Robots.txt, sitemaps and the site icon are now always served normally, and the page no longer leaks your real site title in the browser tab.
  • Block Spacing Edits No Longer Undo Each Other — Setting the top padding and then the bottom padding on the same block used to silently reset the first one back to the template default. Each adjustment now sticks, and clearing a value cleanly returns it to the template default.
  • No More Dead Ends in the Editor — For components edited through a settings panel, the element-level editing tools no longer appear. They used to look like they worked in the editor but the changes vanished on save — those entry points are now correctly hidden.
  • Tighter Spacing on Phones — Section spacing on mobile was too generous on several blocks, and when two of them sat next to each other the gap could reach nearly 200px of empty screen. Those blocks now follow the same responsive spacing rhythm as the rest of the library, so pages feel compact on phones while keeping their airy look on desktop.
  • Cleaner Timeline Component — The horizontal timeline / company history block now has a lighter card style with clear hover highlights, soft fade edges instead of hard-cut cards, and automatically centers itself (hiding the scroll arrows) when there aren’t enough entries to fill the row on wide screens.
  • More Predictable Quick Styles — Background colour, text colour, alignment and width picked in the quick style panel now apply consistently across phone, tablet and desktop, while spacing and font size stay adjustable per device — so a colour you set once no longer silently reverts on another screen size.

0.26.0 (中文版)

  • 老站改版不掉 Google 排名 — 占位页现在分两种情况。选「全新网站，还没对外」，访客看到「即将上线」页面，同时让搜索引擎提前认识你的域名；选「网站已经上线过，正在改版」，访客看到「升级中」页面，同时告诉搜索引擎这些页面还在、只是暂时打不开——原有排名会被保住，改完一上线自动恢复。两种情况的默认文案也不一样，老客户不会撞上「即将上线」而误以为公司出事了。
  • 占位页不再挡住 Google 抓取整站 — 之前占位页会把 robots.txt 一起顶掉，可能导致 Google 停止抓取整个网站。现在 robots.txt、网站地图和站点图标一律正常返回，浏览器标签也不再泄露真实站点标题。
  • 区块间距不再互相覆盖 — 之前先调上内边距、再调下内边距，第一次的设置会悄悄变回模板默认值。现在每次调整都会保留，清空某个值也会干净地回到模板默认。
  • 编辑器不再有「改了不生效」的假开关 — 通过配置面板编辑的组件，不再显示元素级编辑入口。这类入口以前在编辑器里看着能改、保存后却会丢，现在已正确隐藏。
  • 手机端区块间距收紧 — 部分区块在手机上的上下留白偏大，两个区块相邻时空白最多能叠到近 200px，要多滑一屏才看到内容。现已统一到与其他组件一致的分端间距节奏，手机上更紧凑，电脑端保持原有的舒展效果。
  • 时间轴组件视觉优化 — 横向时间轴（企业历程）组件卡片样式更清爽，悬停高亮更明显，两端改为渐隐过渡替代生硬裁切；当条目较少、大屏下撑不满时会自动居中并隐藏左右箭头。
  • 快捷样式表现更符合预期 — 快捷样式面板里选的背景色、文字色、对齐和宽度现在手机/平板/电脑三端统一生效，间距和字号仍可分端单独调整——不会再出现某个屏幕尺寸下设好的颜色到另一端就失效的情况。

0.25.0

  • Configurable Product Inquiry Form — Your product inquiry form is now managed in one global setting with multilingual translations, instead of being repeated per product — update it once and it applies site-wide.
  • Safer Language Code Editing — Language codes in the translation editors are now picked from a dropdown instead of typed by hand, preventing silent translation failures from a mistyped code.
  • More Consistent Spacing & Style Controls — Fixed the three spacing/background/text style presets so each keeps to its own width range and no longer bleeds into the others when combined.
  • Cleaner Product Page Layout — Product overview and specification sections now use consistent backgrounds and dividers, so the page reads as one connected layout instead of mismatched blocks.
  • Product Specs & Related Products, Your Way — Specification position, column count and sort order are now configurable per product, and you can toggle related products on or off.

0.25.0 (中文版)

  • 询盘表单改为全局设置 — 产品询盘表单不再需要逐个产品配置，统一在全局设置中管理并支持多语言译文，改一处即可全站生效。
  • 语言代码改为下拉选择 — 翻译编辑器里的语言代码从手动输入改为下拉选择，避免手滑打错导致翻译静默失效。
  • 修复间距/背景/文字样式互相干扰 — 三档间距、背景、文字工具类现在各自独立生效，不再因为叠加使用而超出预期宽度区间。

  • Step 4 生成同步修复 — 建站 Step 4 的 AI 页面生成也采用相同方式传递站点画像，大型 profile 不再在到达服务器前被拦截。

0.20.2

  • Know What to Expect From Generated Images — While your site is being built, PufferGo now explains that the photos on the page are placeholders. Our layouts do the heavy lifting; once you swap in your own product photos in the editor, the whole page looks strikingly better.
  • A Helpful Nudge Before Regenerating — Regenerating a page changes its layout and copy, but not its images. If you try to regenerate a page you’ve already built, PufferGo lets you know first — so you don’t spend another generation hoping for different photos.
  • Header Menu Polish — Fixed the highlighted category in the product dropdown turning dark on hover, keeping the menu readable as you browse.

0.20.2 (中文版)

  • 生成配图心里有底 — 建站过程中，PufferGo 会明确告诉你页面里的图片是占位示意图。真正撑起页面的是我们的排版组件，等你在编辑器里换上自己的产品实拍，整个页面会瞬间高大上。
  • 重新生成前的贴心提醒 — 重新生成只会更换排版和文案，不会更换图片。当你对已经生成好的页面再次点击生成时，PufferGo 会先提醒一句，免得你为了换图白白多生成一次。
  • 页头菜单细节优化 — 修复了产品下拉菜单中当前选中分类在鼠标悬浮时文字变黑的问题，浏览时更清晰易读。

0.20.1

  • Smoother Product Menu on More Header Styles — The flicker-free, two-column product dropdown now works on the Stacked Flyout header too, so browsing between categories stays smooth no matter which header style you’ve picked.
  • Updates Now Take Effect Reliably — Fixed an issue where some scripts and styles could stay cached after a plugin update. Improvements and fixes now appear right away, without needing to clear your browser or CDN cache by hand.

0.20.1 (中文版)

  • 更多页头样式也享受顺滑产品菜单 — 无闪烁、两栏式的产品下拉菜单现在同样支持 Stacked Flyout 页头，无论你选用哪种页头样式，在分类之间浏览都保持顺滑。
  • 更新更可靠地生效 — 修复了插件更新后部分脚本和样式可能仍被旧缓存挡住的问题。改进和修复现在会即时呈现，无需手动清理浏览器或 CDN 缓存。

0.20.0

  • WooCommerce Store Support — PufferGo now works side by side with WooCommerce. If you sell online, your shop and product pages can optionally adopt PufferGo’s polished templates, while your inquiry-based catalog products keep working exactly as before. The two product systems coexist cleanly — no confusing mode switch to flip, everything follows what you’ve enabled.
  • Cleaner, Consistent Product Pagination — Product listings now use the same refined page navigation as the rest of your site, and every page fills a complete grid, so you no longer see awkward half-empty rows or an unexpected extra page.
  • Zoomable Product Images — Visitors can click a product’s main image to view it full-size in a lightbox, and images now display without awkward cropping.
  • Smoother Product Image Editing — The product editor now recommends the ideal 1600×1600 square image size and arranges thumbnails in a tidy, full-width row.
  • Paste Map Embeds Directly — You can paste a full map embed code straight into the location map field — no more digging out just the URL.
  • Smoother Product Menu — The header’s product dropdown now switches between categories without flicker or momentary blank states.

0.20.0 (中文版)

  • WooCommerce 商店支持 — PufferGo 现在可与 WooCommerce 并肩工作。如果你做线上交易，商店页和商品详情页可以选择套用 PufferGo 的精致模板，而原有的询盘型产品照常运作。两套产品体系干净共存——不再有让人困惑的模式开关，一切按你启用的功能自动生效。
  • 产品分页更统一更清爽 — 产品列表现在与站内其他页面使用同一套精致的翻页导航，且每页都铺满整齐的网格，不再出现半空的行或莫名多出的一页。
  • 产品图可点击放大 — 访客点击产品主图即可在灯箱中查看原图，图片也不再被生硬裁切。
  • 产品图编辑更顺手 — 产品编辑器现在会提示推荐的 1600×1600 正方形尺寸，缩略图也铺成整齐的整行排列。
  • 地图可直接粘贴嵌入代码 — 现在可以把整段地图嵌入代码直接粘进地图字段，无需再单独抠出网址。
  • 产品菜单更顺滑 — 顶部导航的产品下拉在切换分类时不再闪烁或短暂空白。

0.18.1

short_description: AI website builder built for export. Quickly create high-converting B2B brand sites optimized for Google SEO.
description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
